description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, including dynamic decimal precision and optional credit suffixes. It ensures consistent display of currency values across the application, especially focused on USD formatting with added credits calculation.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with options for currency code, decimal precision, and optional credits suffix. Handles dynamic precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Helper function that formats USD amount with credits appended, using default credit conversion rate (20,000 credits per USD).
